sample_unit: clinicians (34 survey responses across two rounds)

links.outcome: Clinician-reported accuracy limitations of ambient scribe notes in the ED
links.effect: Accuracy limitations were a recurring concern in 10/34 responses, while 32/34 (94%) reported enhanced documentation quality. Accuracy was not measured against a reference standard.
links.quote: Content analysis identified documentation efficiency (21/34) and note detail capture (21/34) as the most emphasized strengths, with accuracy limitations (10/34) and workflow friction (6/34) as recurring concerns.

unlisted_practices: Using a human scribe together with the ambient AI scribe rather than as a substitute (16/18 responses from clinicians with prior human-scribe experience)

screen.reason: Evaluates clinician perceptions and experiences following the real-world deployment of an ambient AI scribe (Ambience) across two emergency departments via surveys and qualitative analysis.
